Built with /MD so the MSVC C runtime is imported and stays attributed to data/MSVC. v143, not the v141_xp/v120_xp that upstream pins and Rapid7 distributes - the gem rows carry the distributed toolset. Only metsrv is built; the kiwi extension stays off, mimikatz being issue #60. Nothing built here is run, configured or packaged into a payload.
